content:
Last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, Apple TV announced a slew of news, including the premiere date for the fourth season of Silo.

Silo season 4 will debut in summer 2027 and will be the final season of the show.

Silo season 3 is currently airing (watch here), with new episodes dropping weekly until September 4.

But last weekend at San Diego Comic-Con, Apple surprised Silo fans alongside news about other sci-fi shows.

Silo season 4 will arrive next summer and conclude the series.

Here's the announcement post from Apple TV on X:

In the streaming era, it can take years for shows to release new seasons, and that's especially true for big-budget sci-fi productions like Silo.

However, Apple has been aggressive about speeding up the return of some of its shows through early renewals. In the case of Silo, seasons 3 and 4 were started at the same time and filmed back to back.

We still have six more weeks of new Silo episodes to enjoy. But after this season wraps up, fans won't have to wait long for season 4.

What do you think of Silo season 3 so far? Let us know in the comments below.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, but you can get a discount through an Apple One bundle.
